title: aethusa agrestis
intro: Aethusa agrestis, commonly known as fool's parsley, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae) that is often mistaken for wild carrot due to its similar appearance. The health benefits of Aethusa agrestis include its use as a diuretic, to stimulate digestion, and to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis. Its therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its ability to stimulate the nervous system, improve circulation, and as a mild laxative. The bioactive constituents of Aethusa agrestis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
